summary: Replay the ndmc main-loop producer side for one marker slice: source-faithful nneutrals from beam power/energy/fractions, per-fraction initial level-state validation, and the store_neutrals full/half/third population accumulation plus flux_tot from per-segment deposition records.

identity.relation: nneutrals = 1e6*injected_power_mw / (1e3*injection_energy_kev*e0*(f1 + f2/2 + f3/3)) with the source-faithful e0 = 1.60217733e-19 (src/fidasim.f90:69); reference initial level state states[q,0] = nneutrals*fraction_q/cell_volume with all other levels zero; per fraction q in {1,2,3}: pop[q][:,cell] += normalized_density per record (store_neutrals), flux_tot[q] += segment_flux*cell_volume per record, deposited = sum(flux_tot).
identity.direction: beam power + energy + current fractions + cell volume + nlaunch + level count + grid shape + initial states + three initial population arrays + per-fraction ordered segment deposition records (+ optional expected flux totals) -> nneutrals, energy weight factor, reference initial states, accumulated full/half/third populations, per-fraction and total deposited particles per s, layout diagnostics
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM NDMC束中性沉积生产者 operator (framework node N3; source anchors src/fidasim.f90:12990-13119 ndmc main loop, 10428-10482 update_neutrals/store_neutrals, 69 e0). Single-rank, bounded to one marker slice: no random numbers, no plasma/field projections, no MPI/OpenMP runtime. The e0 fork is an existing inter-asset divergence: nbi-injected-neutrals-normalization uses the CODATA 2018 value 1.602176634e-19 (rel ~4.34e-7 off the frozen trace) while nbi-component-initial-state uses the source value like this producer; the initial-state gate deliberately rejects a CODATA-e0 normalization and the fork stays with expert adjudication. nlaunch semantics (reviewer finding, pending expert adjudication): the source divides dens by nlaunch before store_neutrals, so the consumed records carry per-marker-normalized densities; callers must not re-normalize. Unit reconciliation: the seeded level states are source rate densities in cm^-3 s^-1 (nneutrals in particles/s per volume), the consumed normalized_density_cm_inv3 records are true cm^-3 densities, and flux*volume accumulates particles/s; the saved arm's initial_states_cm_inv3 field name mislabels that carried unit, so the public name uses the precise *_cm_inv3_s_inv form.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with registered hardenings except the registered signed-flux acceptance: the saved arm's document declares nonnegative segment records and its implementation rejects negative ones, while the source-signed arithmetic is kept here (bounded incompatibility, pending expert adjudication)
identity.geometry: one marker slice over the caller-declared Cartesian beam grid; population arrays of shape (n_levels, nx, ny, nz)
identity.coordinates: power in MW, energy in keV, cell volume in cm^3, states in cm^-3 s^-1 (source rate density), population densities in cm^-3, deposition in s^-1; cell indices one-based
identity.boundary: finite nonnegative power; finite positive energy, cell volume and nlaunch; finite nonnegative fractions with at least one positive; genuine positive integer nlevels and grid shape; finite nonnegative initial states and population arrays; records keyed exactly by neutral type 1..3 with in-grid one-based integer cell indices; no colrad execution, track generation, MC sampling, reservoir writes, MPI/OpenMP runtime or HDF5 schema
assumptions: Per-segment deposition records come from the N3 beam-neutral deposition loop with dens/nlaunch already applied.
A brand-new marker slice typically passes all-zero initial population arrays; the accumulation carries any prior content forward.

inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; at least one positive.

inputs.name: grid_shape
inputs.constraints: A genuine positive integer triple (registered hardening: the saved arm's astype(int) silently truncated whole-number floats such as 2.0).

inputs.name: initial_states_cm_inv3_s_inv
inputs.description: Per-fraction main-loop entry level-state rate densities.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; must equal nneutrals*current_fraction/cell_volume with the source-faithful e0 (rtol 1e-9); a CODATA-e0 NBI normalization is rejected by this gate (registered source-faithful choice).

inputs.description: Full-energy population density before this slice.

inputs.name: initial_population_density_half
inputs.description: Half-energy population density before this slice.

inputs.description: Third-energy population density before this slice.

inputs.name: per_fraction_segment_depositions
inputs.description: Ordered per-segment deposition records keyed by neutral type 1..3.
inputs.constraints: Keys genuine integer neutral types 1..3 (bools rejected); a zero current_fraction rejects supplied records (source cycle); each record carries grid_index_one_based (in-grid one-based integer triple), normalized_density_cm_inv3 (finite nonnegative [n_levels]) and segment_flux_per_cm3_s (finite scalar, sign carried: (iflux - sum(states))/nlaunch is signed and a net level-population gain over a segment yields a negative flux).

inputs.description: Optional caller cross-check of the flux totals.
inputs.constraints: Finite (signed, matching the signed accumulation); flux_tot must match componentwise within rtol 1e-9.

outputs.description: Per-fraction reference initial level-state rate densities.

outputs.constraints: True whenever the call returns; mismatches raise instead.

outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; initial content carried forward.

outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; initial content carried forward.

outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; initial content carried forward.

outputs.name: flux_tot_per_fraction
outputs.description: Per-fraction summed segment flux times cell volume.
outputs.constraints: Finite (signed; a net level-population gain over segments yields a negative component); accumulation order matches the source (per-record flux*dv, unpermuted).

outputs.name: deposited_particles_per_s
outputs.description: Total deposition, equivalent to the source flux_tot.

outputs.name: store_neutral_event_count_per_fraction
outputs.constraints: Equal to the segment counts here.

outputs.constraints: Always true; MPI partitioning stays outside.

preconditions: Per-segment deposition records from the N3 beam-neutral deposition loop for the same marker slice and grid.

excluded: colrad execution, track generation, MC sampling, reservoir updates, writer ownership, MPI/OpenMP runtime and HDF5 schema.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when any scalar, vector, array or record fails its declared constraints, when neutral-type keys are not genuine integers 1..3, when a zero current_fraction supplies records, when a cell index leaves the grid, when the initial states do not reproduce the source-faithful e0 formula (a CODATA-e0 normalization is rejected), or when the optional expected flux totals disagree.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the accumulated populations become non-finite.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a failed call leaves the caller's arrays untouched (the accumulation works on internal copies).

python.signature: run_ndmc_deposition_producer(*, injected_power_mw, injection_energy_kev, current_fractions, beam_grid_cell_volume_cm3, nlaunch, nlevels, grid_shape, initial_states_cm_inv3_s_inv, initial_population_density_full, initial_population_density_half, initial_population_density_third, per_fraction_segment_depositions, expected_deposited_particles_per_s_per_fraction=None)

example.description: The saved package's source-e0 initial-state oracle and population accumulation.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fusion import ELEMENTARY_CHARGE_C, run_ndmc_deposition_producer
fractions = (0.528113, 0.268704, 0.203183)
energy_factor = fractions[0] + fractions[1] / 2 + fractions[2] / 3
nneutrals = 1e6 * 1.7 / (1e3 * 72.5 * ELEMENTARY_CHARGE_C * energy_factor)
states = np.zeros((3, 2))
for q in (1, 2, 3):
    states[q - 1, 0] = nneutrals * fractions[q - 1] / 8.0
zero = np.zeros((2, 2, 2, 2))
result = run_ndmc_deposition_producer(
    injected_power_mw=1.7, injection_energy_kev=72.5, current_fractions=fractions,
    beam_grid_cell_volume_cm3=8.0, nlaunch=10.0, nlevels=2, grid_shape=(2, 2, 2),
    initial_states_cm_inv3_s_inv=states,
    initial_population_density_full=zero, initial_population_density_half=zero,
    initial_population_density_third=zero,
    per_fraction_segment_depositions={1: [{'grid_index_one_based': (1, 1, 1),
        'normalized_density_cm_inv3': np.full(2, 2.0), 'segment_flux_per_cm3_s': 0.5}]})
assert np.isclose(result['deposited_particles_per_s'], 4.0)
assert np.allclose(result['population_density_full'][:, 0, 0, 0], 2.0)
try:
    run_ndmc_deposition_producer(
        injected_power_mw=1.7, injection_energy_kev=72.5, current_fractions=fractions,
        beam_grid_cell_volume_cm3=8.0, nlaunch=10.0, nlevels=2, grid_shape=(2.0, 2, 2),
        initial_states_cm_inv3_s_inv=states, initial_population_density_full=zero,
        initial_population_density_half=zero, initial_population_density_third=zero,
        per_fraction_segment_depositions={})
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('a float grid_shape must be rejected (registered hardening)')
example.expected: The saved probes reproduce; the float grid_shape raises ValueError per the registered hardening.

scope: Saved-package oracles: source-e0 nneutrals and initial states (frozen-trace values), population accumulation, initial-population continuation, expected flux cross-check, out-of-grid index rejection, zero-fraction rejection, CODATA-e0 rejection.
Registered hardenings: genuine integer grid shape (the saved arm silently truncated floats); finite accumulated populations.
verification.evidence_ceiling: The maintained direct tests reproduce the saved oracles and exercise the fail-closed contracts. No colrad execution, MC sampling, MPI reduction or HDF5 handling is asserted. The saved FIDASIM bundle supports bounded historical development comparison only.
known_limitations: Bounded incompatibility (cross-asset review finding, pending expert adjudication): the saved arm's operator document declares segment_flux_per_cm3_s nonnegative and its implementation rejects negative records, but the source flux = (iflux - sum(states))/nlaunch is signed and the N3/N4 handoff's (sum(previous) - sum(next))/nlaunch can legitimately go negative when the colrad advance's rate matrix has inflow (population) terms that outweigh its losses (a loss-only matrix with all column sums <= 0 cannot produce a gain). This port keeps the source-signed arithmetic and requires only finiteness, so a valid N3 handoff that the saved arm would reject is accepted here.

The e0 fork between nbi-injected-neutrals-normalization (CODATA 2018) and this producer's source-faithful constant is an open expert-adjudication item; the source's implicit 1 s convention for the rate-density states is not proven.
The nlaunch normalization semantics (dens/nlaunch applied before store_neutrals) require callers to pass already-normalized records; the declaration form stays with expert adjudication.
Single-rank, one-marker-slice scope; no MPI/OpenMP or full-program parity is claimed.
